description.zh: 是否自动创建镜像仓库
description.en: Specifies whether a repository is automatically created when an image is pushed to a repository that does not yet exist in the namespace.

description.zh:
自动创建仓库默认类型，取值：

- `PUBLIC`：公开

- `PRIVATE`：私有
description.en:
The default type of automatically created repositories. Valid values:

- `PUBLIC`: public

- `PRIVATE`: private

description.zh: 命名空间名称，长度为 2 - 120 位，可填写小写英文字母、数字，可使用的分隔符包括“_”、“-”、“.”（分隔符不能在首位或末位）
description.en: The name of the namespace. The name must be 2 to 120 characters long and can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and the following separators: underscores (\_), hyphens (-), and periods (.). A separator cannot be used as the first or last character.

title.zh: 创建镜像仓库命名空间

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr create-namespace --instance-id cri-xkx6vujuhay00000 --namespace-name namespace1 --auto-create-repo true --default-repo-type PUBLIC --default-repo-configuration example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr CreateNamespace --region cn-hangzhou --NamespaceName namespace1 --DefaultRepoType PUBLIC --InstanceId 'cri-xkx6vujuhay00000' --AutoCreateRepo true --DefaultRepoConfiguration 'example-string'
